args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. First rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%. v2.3.1 should be investigated and not re-released until root cause is identified.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback**: I rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed, due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollback completed in all regions. Verified the service is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 everywhere with the error rate down to **0.2%**.

3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), the current healthy state, and a note that v2.3.1 should be investigated before any re-release. Note: the incident-creation call reported a timeout, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created (no duplicate was opened).
